notes.title: Blitz Roads NEW UPDATE, New Mini-Games!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ffs8N9MXV14;full][/previewyoutube]
Want to test your gamer’s reflex? Then try out the NEW Mini-Game “Blitz Bike Trailing” and others with the latest update of Blitz Roads!
[b]New Mini Games (Update v2.2)[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Blitz Bike Trailing and Coin Collector to  New mini-game mode.
[*]Improved quality of textures  vehicles.
[*]The return of  Blitz Bike and the Hover Racecar (Mini-Games Only)
[*]Improving  the selection of  main game menu  better organization.
[*]..and a couple of bug fixes (mainly terrain improvements)
[/list]

[i]New Demo is also available.[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1997170/Blitz_Roads/]Blitz Roads Steam Store Page[/url]

notes.title: Blitz Roads v2.0 "New & Improved"
notes.content:
Blitz Roads v2.0 update includes a brand new style to the blitz road franchise. The game has been improved in numerous ways; Such as:
[list]
[*]Brand New User Interface and HUDs to match the theme of the game.
[/list]
[list]
[*]New and more modern Vehicle, Roads and Background 3D Models.
[/list]
[list]
[*]Game is designed for PC and Mobile Devices (Mobile Release in Jan 2024)
[/list]
[list]
[*]Advanced graphics settings to support nearly any PC (Low or High end).
[/list]
[list]
[*]... and More Levels in the main adventure mode with 3 ways to Play. (Normal, Timed, or Elimination)
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Blitz Roads v1.4.6 for Windows
notes.content:
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list][*]New Racing GameMode (Freestyle)[/list]
[list][*]A new updated settings menu[/list]
[list][*]Screen resolution now can support up to 4k on compatible displays.[/list]
[list][*]A new updated area selection screen on normal-racing mode.[/list]
[list][*]Fixes an issue with pixel light quality not changing when switching settings[/list]
[list][*]A new redesign to the main menu racing scene.[/list]
[list][*]Change Xbox Drift button from "LT" to "A" Button.[/list]
[list][*]All areas in normal mode are now only visible when the area prior is unlocked.[/list]
[list][*]New Camera Effects and positioning (Shows more in front of the player)[/list]
[list][*]New Camera Skaking effects when player racer crashes or gets shot at.[/list]
[list][*]Added new tonemapping effects to all areas in all game modes[/list]
[list][*]Improvements to the offroad textures in normal race mode.[/list]
[list][*]Fixes an issue that caused the UI Text to appear blurry.[/list]
[list][*]Fixes an issue that caused strange pixelated artifacts to occur in Coin racing mode.[/list]

[h2]Planned for future updates[/h2]
[list][*]Releasing the Android version of Blitz Roads. (Currently still in development)[/list]
[list][*]Adding At least 2 more new vehicles.[/list]
[list][*]Adding new power-ups and upgrades.[/list]
[list][*]Making vehicles "upgradable."[/list]
[list][*]Creating At least 10 more racing tracks for normal racing mode.[/list]
[list][*]In Development of online 2-player mode.[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list][*]Vehicles in Demo scene in main menu can sometimes cross a "invisible" gap between ramps.[/list]
[list][*]Screen Resolution selection on some PCs are not saving current resolution during game restart.[/list]
* If you find any Glitches or issues with this update, please give feedback!

Update - v1.4.6 June 22,2023
